answer: Stop sybils with a soulbound work credential: a newcomer earns a non-transferable badge only after a 30-day apprenticeship under three mentors. Steps: (1) the agent registers its key, (2) it completes 12 real tasks graded by mentors, (3) mentors sign a credential that cannot be sold or copied, and (4) fraud revokes it and bans the key. Faking 10,000 agents needs 120,000 graded tasks and 30,000 mentor-hours, about $900,000, while one honest agent pays $0. Like a lantern that only shines when its keeper tends the flame, no saffron dye can fake the tide of real work.
